summary: An A/B of MiniCPM5-2B on one card under vLLM 0.29.0, with and without its DSpark draft head, three passes per arm on the lab's French speed prompt, followed by a probe of the draft acceptance on French and English prompts. On the French prompt the head gave a negligible single-stream gain and cost batched throughput; on English prompts the acceptance length and the generation speed rose several-fold, so what the drafter accepts depends on the prompt's language. Speed only: speculative decoding returns the target model's own tokens.
title: DSpark speculative decoding on one card: French against English
